sentence: This project studies immune responses that target a polysaccharide during cholera, to understand how the body is protected against the disease.
This project tries to find out how Shigella flexneri uses signaling when it infects human cells to grow and avoid the immune system.
This project builds a way to combine brain data from many molecular levels to find variants and genes that cause Alzheimers disease.
This project automates the growing of tissue in a closed system that connects sensors and bioreactors to control how cells become tissue.
This project studies how a gene linked to neurodevelopmental disorders affects cell differentiation and proliferation in early human brain development.
This project studies inflammation in human dopamine grafts in mouse models of Parkinson's disease and edits genes to help graft cells resist it.
This project studies how the body regulates what antibodies recognize.
This project collects and stores human samples from patients with Lyme disease and runs laboratory tests on them to support other research.
This project combines human brain organoids with tools that record their activity over time to study brain maturation, function and disease.
This project uses deep learning to make up for lost signals so that prosthetic devices for people with upper-limb absence work better.
This project develops a deep learning method to check radiation dose in patients with early-stage non-small cell lung cancer.
This project uses long read sequencing and bioinformatics to guide the synthesis of antibiotics encoded by microbial dark matter.
This project studies what psychiatric disorders share in the brain and in genetics by analyzing imaging and genetics data sets together.
This project studies how fusion oncoproteins and the condensates they form drive translocation renal cell carcinoma, a kidney cancer.
This project builds tools to control gene expression and chromatin state and tests how many human transcription factor protein sequences behave.
This project studies how T helper 17 cells keep their identity and change into other cell types in autoimmune disease.
This project offers animal tumor models and imaging tools to support preclinical cancer research.
This project uses fission yeast and human cells to look for drugs that block part of the virus behind COVID-19.
This project sets up a core to improve the ability to do cancer, infectious disease, mental health and health services research.
This project studies how an estrogen receptor and previous pregnancy affect blood pressure later in life in women.
